pages.title: Femtoscale Transistor
pages.text: A single-qubit switch, the smallest logic gate there can be. One qubit flips between states and a quantum dot opens or closes to current in response. It is invisible to the eye, switches in femtoseconds, and wastes almost no energy doing so.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Femto Fabricator I placed a Qubit inside a Quantum Dot coated in Quantum-Dot Photoresist. Flipping the qubit opened or closed the dot to current: one bit, one switch.
